# Vendored browser libraries

Unmodified release files, served to the design iframe and to headless Chromium.

| File | Package | License |
|---|---|---|
| `tailwindcss-browser.js` | `@tailwindcss/browser@4.3.3` (`dist/index.global.js`) | MIT |
| `alpine.min.js` | `alpinejs@3.17.4` (`dist/cdn.min.js`) | MIT |
| `axe.min.js` | `axe-core@4.14.0` (`axe.min.js`) | MPL-2.0 |
| `lucide.min.js` | `lucide@1.53.0` (`dist/umd/lucide.min.js`) | ISC |

Update: `npm pack <package>@<version>` in an empty folder, copy the file above, bump the table.
